propositions: A project-only coaching criterion `project.symbol-reference-completeness` must be added to route advisory (non-blocking) guidance when a plan's affected-file or call-site inventory is hand-enumerated or demonstrably incomplete rather than derived from the symbol graph.
The criterion must route to plan-review only (not code-review) because code-review's closed `applies_when` vocabulary cannot fire on project.* ids, making any such move dead by construction.
The coaching move template must direct re-derivation using both `find_referencing_symbols` and a string-literal sweep (monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib) to cover sites the LSP cannot resolve.

Detection of incomplete inventory is largely redundant with existing built-in blocking criteria (G1G2, G6, E4); the distinctive value is the method coaching delivered through move applicability rather than move selection.
The criterion must be configured with `default_posture: "advisory"` and carry no `blocking_enabled` key (code-review-only convention); plan-review's `threshold_for` only reads posture.
